privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service (Section 6.5) explicitly authorize Zillow to use Customer Data for AI/ML Activities including designing, developing, pre-training, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating ML systems. A carve-out applies: Agent-Only Customer Data (end customers without a Zillow account) is NOT used for Zillow products other than FUB. However, Mutual Customer Data (end customers who also have a Zillow account) is subject to Zillow's full Privacy Notice with fewer restrictions. The AI features page states 'it is not used to train global AI models or any external systems,' which partially softens but does not override the broad ToS grant. Internal training for FUB service improvement is permitted and likely occurs.
privacy.data_region: Not disclosed. Vendor states 'leading cloud platform technologies' without naming the provider or geographic region. Presumed US-based given Zillow Group infrastructure.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: 256-bit AES encryption; HTTPS enforced for all connections (data at rest and in transit)

security.value: Continuous backups every second, retained for 35 days across multiple redundant data centers

security.value: Annual Google security audits plus independent third-party assessments. SOC 3 report publicly available, latest dated October 31, 2024.

security.name: Bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure

security.name: PCI compliance

security.name: Data segmentation

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Not explicitly mentioned. Annual Google security audits and independent assessments are referenced but penetration test cadence is not disclosed.

products.name: FUB CRM Platform
products.data_scope: Lead and contact data, communications (calls, texts, emails), deal tracking, calendar integrations. Governed by FUB Privacy Notice Addendum to Zillow Privacy Notice. Agent-Only Customer Data (end customers without Zillow accounts) has stricter cross-product protections; Mutual Customer Data (end customers who also have Zillow accounts) is shared with Zillow's broader ecosystem.
products.notes: Core product. Available via Grow ($69/user/month), Pro ($499/month for 10 users), and Platform ($1,000/month for 30 users) subscription tiers. 250+ lead source integrations. Founded 2011, acquired by Zillow Group December 2023.

products.name: FUB AI
products.data_scope: Uses existing CRM data (calls, texts, emails, lead activity) within each customer account. Terms of Service authorize AI/ML training on customer data for service improvement and product development.
products.notes: Included in all subscription plans at no additional cost. Features include Smart Summaries (call/lead recap), Suggested Tasks, Smart Messages (AI-drafted texts and emails), and Predictive Lead Prioritization (integrates Zillow buyer intent signals). Some features require FUB Calling add-on.

products.name: FUB Pixel
products.data_scope: Tracks visitor behavior on agent websites; data flows into FUB CRM as lead source data. Subject to same privacy framework.
products.notes: Tracking pixel for real estate agent and team websites.

products.name: FUB Calling (Add-on)
products.data_scope: Call recordings and transcripts processed and stored within the CRM account.
products.notes: Paid add-on at $39/user/month on Grow plan. Unlimited calling and texting included in Pro and Platform plans.

products.name: Zillow Pro Integration
products.data_scope: Connects FUB to Zillow's buyer and seller lead network. When an end customer has both a Zillow account and a record in the agent's FUB system ('Mutual Customer'), their data is governed by Zillow's full Privacy Notice, not just the FUB Addendum, enabling Zillow to use that data across its products.
products.notes: Launched late 2025. Significant industry controversy documented in real estate trade press (HousingWire, Notorious ROB, BAM). Key competitive risk: Zillow gains access to an agent's client data when that client also uses Zillow.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based. Per-user on Grow ($69/user/month); team-based on Pro ($499/month flat for first 10 users, $49/month each additional) and Platform ($1,000/month flat for first 30 users, $20/month each additional). Annual billing saves approximately 16%. No long-term contracts required. 14-day free trial.
compare.data_residency: Not disclosed. Vendor uses 'leading cloud platform technologies' without specifying provider or geographic region. No EU data residency option mentioned.

flags: Zillow ownership creates Mutual Customer Data risk: any FUB end customer who also has a Zillow account has their data governed by Zillow's full Privacy Notice, enabling Zillow to use that data across its own products. This is a significant conflict-of-interest concern for real estate agents competing with Zillow's own buyer-agent business.

Terms of Service (Section 6.5) explicitly authorize AI/ML training on customer data for new product development. The AI features page says data is 'not used to train global AI models or any external systems,' which softens but does not contractually override the ToS grant. These two statements are in tension.
No GDPR compliance framework or DPA is publicly documented. The privacy notice is a US-focused Addendum to Zillow's Privacy Notice with no explicit EU data rights beyond California (CCPA).
Data storage geography is not disclosed. 'Leading cloud platform technologies' provides no actionable compliance information for customers with data residency requirements.
No formal bug bounty program: email-only Vulnerability Disclosure Policy with no monetary reward and no partnership with HackerOne or Bugcrowd.
ISO 27001 certification not held and not mentioned.
HIPAA data is explicitly prohibited from upload: not suitable for any use case involving protected health information.

Privacy policy change (effective November 15, 2025) attracted significant industry criticism regarding Zillow's expanded access to agent client data. Multiple real estate trade publications documented the controversy.
